selection: First 40 one-goal team/matches in date/fixture/team order from 2026-01-01 in 2025/26; exclude prior assist development and primary/delta controls. No assist outcomes read for selection.
unit: One goal by that team, so official FPL match assists uniquely identify its recipient or no recipient.
freeze: Freeze engine.py, rules.py and protocol SHA256 and write predictions before reading expected FPL assists.
acceptance: Zero incorrect resolved goal decisions. Unresolved decisions are reported separately, never counted correct. Any failed route is withheld from historical automatic approval; no tuning on these labels.
limits: Previously stored official FPL snapshots; new evaluation split, not fresh observations or independent Opta-provider validation. Rare routes may be absent; unit/development tests are not independent validation.
